Container.Name: traefik-manager-agent
Container.Overview: Puts an Unraid server under a Traefik Manager you already run somewhere else. The agent exposes this server Traefik config, certificates, logs and CrowdSec to that hub over one authenticated port, so its routes are edited from the same UI as every other server. It has no UI of its own. Install Traefik Manager first, add a server under Settings, Agents to generate the API key, then paste that key here.
Container.Requires: A running Traefik Manager elsewhere to connect to, and Traefik on this server with its API reachable from this container.

Config.Name: Agent Port
Config.Description: Port the Traefik Manager hub connects to. Publish it only on a network the hub can reach.

Config.Name: Config Directory
Config.Description: Your Traefik dynamic config on this server. Point it at the directory Traefik loads, or at a single .yml file. The agent writes here, so it cannot be read only.

Config.Name: Backups Directory
Config.Description: Timestamped backups taken before every change, and the git clone when backups go to a repository. Without this mapping everything here is lost each time the container is updated.

Config.Name: API Key
Config.Description: Key the hub authenticates with. Generate it in Traefik Manager under Settings, Agents, then paste the same value here.

Config.Name: Traefik API URL
Config.Description: URL of the Traefik API on this server. Usually http://traefik:8080 when both containers share a Docker network.

Config.Name: Static Config / Plugins - traefik.yml
Config.Description: Optional: this server traefik.yml, for the Static Config editor and the Plugins tab. Must be the same file Traefik itself reads, and read-write to allow saving. Also set the Static Config Path variable to match.

Config.Name: Certs - acme.json
Config.Description: Optional: this server acme.json, for certificate expiry and for spotting certificates nothing uses. Also set the acme.json Path variable to /app/acme.json. Read-only is enough to view them; set it read-write, with a Restart Method, to remove certificates from this server.

Config.Name: Logs - access.log
Config.Description: Optional: this server Traefik access log, for the Logs tab. Also set the Access Log Path variable to /app/logs/access.log.

Config.Name: Docker Socket (direct restart)
Config.Description: Optional: only for Restart Method socket. A socket proxy is the safer choice. Host path: /var/run/docker.sock

Config.Name: Restart Signals Volume
Config.Description: Optional: only for Restart Method poison-pill. Map a shared path here and at the same target in your watcher container, then point Signal File Path inside it. Leave blank for the other restart methods.

Config.Name: Config Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the config mapped above. Change it only if you mapped the config somewhere other than /app/config.

Config.Name: Static Config Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container to traefik.yml, for example /etc/traefik/traefik.yml. Leave blank unless you mapped it above.

Config.Name: acme.json Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container to acme.json. Accepts several files comma-separated, or a directory, for one storage file per resolver.

Config.Name: Access Log Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container to the Traefik access log.

Config.Name: Plugins Directory
Config.Description: Path inside the container to Traefik local plugins directory, for the Plugins tab.

Config.Name: Traefik API Username
Config.Description: Optional: basic-auth username, when the Traefik API sits behind a basicAuth middleware.

Config.Name: Traefik API Password
Config.Description: Optional: basic-auth password for the Traefik API.

Config.Name: Skip Traefik API TLS Verification
Config.Description: Set true when the Traefik API URL is https with a self-signed or Origin certificate.

Config.Name: Restart Method
Config.Description: How this agent restarts Traefik after a static config change. proxy for a Docker socket proxy, socket for the Docker socket directly, poison-pill for a signal file read by a watcher. Leave blank to disable restarts.

Config.Name: Traefik Container Name
Config.Description: Name of the Traefik container to restart, used by the proxy and socket methods.

Config.Name: Docker Host (socket proxy)
Config.Description: Socket proxy address for Restart Method proxy, for example tcp://socket-proxy:2375.

Config.Name: Signal File Path (poison pill)
Config.Description: File the agent touches to ask a watcher sidecar to restart Traefik, for example /signals/restart.sig. Map the same volume into both containers.

Config.Name: Backup Directory Path
Config.Description: Path inside the container for backups. Change it only if you mapped backups somewhere other than /app/backups.

Config.Name: Backup Retention
Config.Description: Keep only the last N backups per config file. 0 keeps every backup.

Config.Name: Agent Listen Port
Config.Description: Port the agent listens on inside the container. Change the port mapping above to match if you change this.

Config.Name: Rate Limit
Config.Description: Requests per minute accepted from the hub.

Config.Name: Debug Logging
Config.Description: Set true to log every request the agent handles.

Config.Name: CrowdSec LAPI URL
Config.Description: Optional: CrowdSec Local API on this server, for example http://crowdsec:8080. Enables the CrowdSec tab for this server.

Config.Name: CrowdSec API Key
Config.Description: Optional: CrowdSec bouncer key, used to read decisions. Generate with: cscli bouncers add traefik-manager

Config.Name: CrowdSec Machine ID
Config.Description: Optional: CrowdSec machine login, needed to view alerts and to unban. Create with: cscli machines add traefik-manager --auto

Config.Name: CrowdSec Machine Password
Config.Description: Optional: password for the CrowdSec machine login above.

Config.Name: CrowdSec Client Certificate
Config.Description: Optional: path inside the container to a TLS client certificate, when the LAPI requires mTLS instead of a key.

Config.Name: CrowdSec Client Key
Config.Description: Optional: path inside the container to the private key for the client certificate above.

Config.Name: CrowdSec CA Certificate
Config.Description: Optional: path inside the container to the CA that signed the LAPI certificate.

Config.Name: CrowdSec Alert Limit
Config.Description: How many alerts to read at once, 0 to 100000.

Config.Name: CrowdSec Read Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for a CrowdSec LAPI response, 1 to 120.

Config.Name: Git Backup Enabled
Config.Description: Leave false unless this agent pushes to git on its own. The usual setup is Use Host Repository in Traefik Manager under Backups, Git, where the hub pushes this server config to its own repository on a separate branch and nothing is configured here.

Config.Name: Git Backup Repository
Config.Description: Only for a standalone agent: HTTPS URL of the repository to push to.

Config.Name: Git Backup Branch
Config.Description: Only for a standalone agent: branch to push to. Give every server its own branch, or they overwrite each other.

Config.Name: Git Backup Username
Config.Description: Only for a standalone agent: username the token belongs to.

Config.Name: Git Backup Token
Config.Description: Only for a standalone agent: personal access token with write access to the repository.

Config.Name: Git Backup Auto Push
Config.Description: Only for a standalone agent: push after every change instead of committing locally.

Config.Name: Git Backup Commit Message
Config.Description: Only for a standalone agent: commit message template. {action} and {timestamp} are replaced.
